comparisons.semantic_review: Earlier GMUT proposals cover gauge fixing, perturbative order, constraints, causal cones, matching, screening, and identifiability. None centers cosmological adiabatic residual modes and the assumptions needed to turn a long-wavelength gauge transformation into a soft-limit obligation.

comparisons.title: Color-only status, contrast-token, and monochrome-redundancy accessibility audit
comparisons.nearest_prior_title: CSS generated-content, icon-only state, and print-suppression accessibility audit
comparisons.semantic_review: Earlier accessibility proposals cover reflow, forced colors, print, focus, names, landmarks, figures, forms, links, tables, abbreviations, active content, and CSS-generated meaning. None freezes explicit color tokens, calculates their contrast, and requires status meaning to survive a monochrome representation with a visible non-color cue.

comparisons.title: Stage 20 circular-support, self-citation, and bootstrap-evidence rejection board
comparisons.semantic_review: Earlier Stage 20 proposals cover contradiction, expiry, cut sets, stop rules, regret, value of information, validation budgets, reviewer overlap, multiplicity, sampling, and evidence queues. None rejects a directed assurance graph whose only apparent roots are self-citation or mutually bootstrapped derived receipts.

boundary: Title overlap is a screening signal; semantic novelty is judged across mechanism, evidence object, falsifier, recovery, and gates.
